model_provider.notes: Koppla publicly discusses AI features, but the reviewed public support documentation, AI-related product/blog material, and security information did not identify the model or provider used.

named_customers.notes: Both companies are named on Koppla's references pages, with case-study details confirming their use of the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board listed Founders Associate and Senior Product Engineer roles; neither title is an AI, ML, machine-learning, or data-science role.

compliance_certs.notes: Koppla's security certification section names ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR. TISAX is also listed by the page but is outside the certification categories requested.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job listings discuss CRM workflows generically or name engineering tools, but do not identify a specific CRM or sales/marketing system.

product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes collaborative construction scheduling and names its intended professional audiences.
product_one_liner.value: Koppla provides collaborative construction-project scheduling and control software for general contractors, general planners, project developers, and architects, helping them coordinate schedules and reduce project-delivery risks.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The public company page identifies the founders but does not provide a complete, dated leadership roster; no verifiable C-level or VP join/departure within the time window was found.
